title: Chloroprene copolymer latex composition and molded article of same
abstract: The present invention relates to a chloroprene copolymer latex composition, a chloroprene copolymer rubber molded article and an immersion product; and the chloroprene copolymer latex composition contains (A) a chloroprene copolymer and (B) a vulcanization accelerator. The chloroprene copolymer (A) contains chloroprene and a monomer unit derived from 2-methyl-1, 3-butadiene. The above-described chloroprene copolymer latex composition contains, as the vulcanization accelerator (B), a carbamic acid salt vulcanization accelerator and a thiazole vulcanization accelerator. This chloroprene copolymer latex composition enables the production of a molded article that has high flexibility and high tensile strength without using a vulcanization accelerator that has a fear of skin sensitization.
